I haven't had a chance to enter this result into the project folder yet, but this affects our site requirements, our bed design, and potentially our budget and workday schedule. The locate response arrived this morning after the draft workday was already proposed for October 18. So we cannot proceed with excavation or bed assembly on October 18 — the earliest we can legally begin that work is October 28, once the permit is posted.
